# 總整理

## Biceps groove landmark

- Start in short axis over the bicipital groove `(V1 03:21)`
- The LHB tendon sits between the greater and lesser tuberosity `03:40`
- See [[Rotator cuff anatomy|the cuff note]] and [[folder/Other note#Section]]

> [!figure] frame_0012.jpg — biceps groove short axis
> Labels: GT = greater tuberosity; LT = lesser tuberosity.
> ![[99Attachment/lecture_example/example_s03.jpg|600]]

[[EMBED s4]]

### Pitfalls

- Anisotropy makes the tendon look dark when the probe tilts [01:02:03]
- ⚠️ A number heard once only: 7 mm (unconfirmed)

## Supraspinatus long axis

- Modified Crass position, probe along the tendon `(V2 10:05)`
- Tear shows as a hypoechoic gap with ==loss of the convex contour==
